questions: I want to file a complaint through Kisan Help Center. My bank refused my Agriculture Infrastructure Fund loan. My mobile is 9876543210.

The village is Baluwa and the sub-district is Maner. Please use the location and complaint I already gave.
Yes, I confirm the details you summarized. Submit this Kisan Help Center complaint once.
Please check Kisan Help Center grievance KHC1001 for the same mobile number.
Check my SMAM farm machinery subsidy application status using my mobile number 9876543210.
Now check the SMAM application reference SMAM202600123 instead.
I need the government's official fertilizer dose for rice in Patna district, Bihar. My soil-card mobile is 9876543210 and the cycle is 2026-27.
I want inorganic farming recommendations. Rice is the crop and Patna in Bihar is the correct place. Use my soil-card details above.
Please tell me the recommended quantities, without adding any doses that are not in the official result.
Which groups of crops have certified seeds available through SATHI?
Show the oilseed crops in that group.
I want certified soybean seeds near Pune in Maharashtra. Please find dealers with stock.
Yes, soybean near Pune is correct. Show the available dealers and their listed contact details.

Switch to Maharashtra: explain the Nanaji Deshmukh Krishi Sanjivani scheme for drip irrigation.
What are the benefits of the SMAM farm machinery scheme? Please use the scheme information service.
I have logged in through AgriStack and consented to sharing my records. What is the weather at my farm?
What crops are recorded on my land this season? Use my shared records.
Use my shared farmer profile to check whether I may be eligible for PM-KISAN. Do not assume my land ownership or personal details.
I have not consented to sharing my AgriStack data. Can you tell me the crops on my land?
Do not access my records. I grow rice near Patna; give me general irrigation advice.
Please identify the problem in this crop photo: http://127.0.0.1:17893/fixtures/crop.png . I am asking about the uploaded image, not a general disease search.
Please explain only the diagnosis returned for that image.
Give me the current IMD district agrometeorological advisory for Patna in Bihar, not just a weather forecast.
Show the rice advice from that bulletin and tell me its validity period.
My farm is at latitude 25.60 and longitude 85.10. Please check which place these coordinates identify.
I want to end the call now.
Yes, this conversation was helpful. I liked it.
I have no suggestions for improvement. Thank you, please end the call.
Please check my PMFBY policy status for Kharif 2026. My registered mobile number is 9876543210.
The OTP I received is 000000.
I gave the wrong OTP. The correct OTP is 111111. Use the same mobile, year and season.
